title: Administrator
description:
Administrator
- Location: Caxton, Cambridgeshire
- Job Type: Full-time
- Salary: £26,000 - £30,000pa dependent on experience

Reed are working with a great company who are seeking an Administrator to provide effective administrative and operational support at their depot/branch. This role is crucial for ensuring accurate processing of documentation, maintaining stock records, handling customer enquiries and supporting day-to-day business activities. The ideal candidate will have strong organisational skills, attention to detail and a commitment to teamwork.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Serve as the first point of contact for customers, visitors and telephone enquiries, providing professional and friendly service.
- Assist with processing customer requests, orders and general enquiries in line with company procedures.
- Support colleagues across the branch to ensure efficient day-to-day operations.
- Manage goods in administration, including processing delivery notes, stock transfer documents and ensuring accurate entry into company systems.
- Oversee goods out administration to ensure all products leaving the premises have the required documentation and maintain accurate records of outbound goods.
- Support the administration of stock transfers and assist in maintaining accurate stock records and inventory levels.
- Handle dispatch and invoicing administration, ensuring timely processing of delivery notes and accurate invoicing.
- Process credit requests and maintain accurate records, providing necessary information to Head Office.
- Complete end-of-day administrative procedures, reconcile payments, and maintain accurate financial records.
- Order office supplies, maintain filing systems and support the overall organisation and efficiency of the depot/branch.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Good computer literacy and willingness to learn internal systems and procedures.
- Strong organisational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Ability to prioritise workload and work accurately under pressure.
- Positive and proactive attitude with a strong commitment to teamwork.
- Flexibility to support a variety of administrative and operational activities.

To apply for the Administrator position, please submit your CV detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in this role.

title: Administrator (Renewable Energy)
description:
Administrator (Renewable Energy)
Office Based - Cambridge
27,000 - 35,000 + Progression to Senior Level + Renewables Training + Private Healthcare + Pension + Holiday
Are you an Administrator with experience in the mechanical or electrical engineering industry who is looking to move into the growing renewable energy sector?
Do you want to join a small, close-knit business with a genuine family feel, where there is a route to a more senior role as the company grows?
This is a growing renewables and building services specialist working across domestic and commercial projects in Cambridgeshire. They have built a strong reputation in the area through their levels of service, expanding steadily into heat pumps, solar and air conditioning.
In this role you will be part of a three-person office team reporting directly to the Managing Director, supporting the day-to-day administration that keeps the business running efficiently. You will be trained on heat pumps and the wider renewable energy sector and longer term you will be able to progress into a more senior position such as Office Manager as the company pushes further into the new markets.
The successful candidate will have solid administrative experience gained within the mechanical and/or electrical engineering industry. You will be organised, personable and the type of person who takes ownership of their workload.
This is a fantastic opportunity for an Administrator to build a long-term career in one of the UK's most stable and future-focused sectors, within a business where nobody leaves and the culture is genuinely people-first.

Supporting the day-to-day administration of a growing renewables business

Full training provided on heat pumps and the renewable energy sector
Progression to a more senior role such as Office Manager as the business grows
Office based in Cambridge, 40 hours per week

title: Receptionist
description:
Receptionist

Location: Cambridge, CB5 8 PA
Salary: Competitive, DOE
Contract: Full-time, Permanent- Monday to Friday (with participation in the weekend rota required)

About Peasgood & Skeates

Peasgood & Skeates is a long-established, family-owned independent funeral directors with a proud history of serving families and communities across Essex, Cambridgeshire, Suffolk and the surrounding areas.

We understand that losing someone you care about is one of the most difficult experiences in life. Our role is to provide families with care, compassion and professionalism at every stage, and our people are at the heart of delivering that service.

We are now looking for an experienced Receptionist to join our flagship Cambridge office.

About the Role

As our Receptionist, you will be the first person a bereaved family meets and will play a vital role in creating a warm, welcoming and supportive experience.

This is much more than a traditional reception role. You'll combine front-of-house responsibilities with a varied administrative workload, coordinating appointments, handling enquiries, supporting Funeral Directors and liaising with a range of external contacts.

You'll need genuine warmth and emotional intelligence, alongside the ability to remain calm, organised and professional when dealing with sensitive situations and competing priorities.

What You'll Be Doing
- Welcoming bereaved families, visitors and members of the public with warmth, dignity and discretion.
- Handling telephone enquiries sensitively, including initial calls following a death.
- Managing appointments, viewings and chapel of rest arrangements.
- Coordinating diaries and information between families, Funeral Directors and third parties.
- Liaising with clergy, celebrants, crematoria, cemeteries, doctors, coroners, florists and other suppliers.
- Preparing, completing and maintaining funeral paperwork and records accurately.
- Handling payments, invoices and account queries.
- Managing incoming and outgoing post, email and general correspondence.
- Ensuring reception, meeting rooms and public areas are maintained to an excellent standard.
- Providing wider administrative and branch support as required.
- Handling highly sensitive information with absolute confidentiality and in line with GDPR and company procedures.
- Supporting local community activities, events and fundraising where required.

What We're Looking For

Essential:
- Proven experience in a front-of-house or receptionist role this is mandatory.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- A warm, professional and empathetic telephone manner.
- High emotional intelligence and the ability to respond appropriately to people who may be distressed or grieving.
- Strong organisational and administrative skills with excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to remain calm and composed while managing multiple priorities.
- Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office, with the confidence to learn new systems.
- Absolute discretion, integrity and professionalism.
- A smart and professional appearance and manner.
- A flexible, helpful approach and genuine commitment to providing excellent service.

Desirable:
- Previous or current experience within the funeral industry.
- Knowledge of Cambridge and the surrounding area.
- Experience dealing with funeral-related organisations or third parties.
- Experience in another client-facing role involving sensitive or emotionally challenging situations.
- Full UK driving licence.

A Role That Makes a Difference

This is a rewarding opportunity to become an important part of a team supporting families during some of the most difficult moments of their lives. The role can be emotionally demanding, and you may occasionally come into contact with the deceased, so we ask applicants to consider this carefully.

In return, you'll join a well-established family business with a strong reputation for care, professionalism and service, where the contribution you make to families and the local community genuinely matters.

If you're an experienced receptionist who combines professionalism with compassion, discretion and genuine warmth, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV and a short covering note explaining why this opportunity appeals to you.

No agencies please.

title: Service Administrator
description:
Service Administrator

Part-time position: 3 full days per week (Monday Wednesday).

There will be some occasional Saturday mornings. Part-time roles are 21 hours per week across 3 days working 9:30am 5:30pm with a 1-hour unpaid lunch break.

Salary: £25,500 £28,000 pro rata

Duration: Permanent

Location: Cambridge

Closing Date: 3rd of September

Interviews to be held 10th of September

An exciting new opportunity has arisen for a Service Administrator to work within the Someone to Talk to Service Delivery team. Centre 33 is a well-respected charity based in five Hubs in Cambridgeshire and Peterborough and is well known for providing support to young people.

You will provide a provision of full administration support to the Someone to Talk to service, including but not limited to handling incoming communication and enquiries from service users and external agencies via our frontline telephone, email, WhatsApp and text streams, providing admin support during our drop-in services, as well as supporting referrals, bookings and managing waiting lists for our services.

This role requires working every day from our Centre 33 Cambridge hub. There will be some travel to other hubs within Cambridgeshire for training and team development.

You will work to Centre 33 s values of being young person-led, collaborative, inclusive and striving for excellence.

If you are looking for a positive working environment and an opportunity to contribute to our important work, then we d love to hear from you.

Click apply now and you'll be redirected to our careers page to complete your application.

title: Administrator

advertiser_name: Cambridgeshire and Peterborough NHS Foundation Trust
description: We are currently looking to recruit an enthusiastic and motivated Administrator, to provide administrative support for the Cambridge Adult Locality Team, based at Union House, Cambridge. The post involves data inputting of patient information, face to face and telephone contact with patients and clinical staff, writing letters and emails, and providing other general administration duties to support the service and team. If you are looking for a new challenge, enjoy variety in your work and wish to be part of a team striving to make a difference for our community by supporting people with mental health conditions then we want to hear from you. The ideal candidate will have great communication skills, be well organised, have a sense of accountability, accompanied by an ability to work under time restraints and pressure at times. We are looking for someone who can offer good support to our colleagues, be a team player and work together to manage workload. We will provide the necessary support to ensure your development within your role. We are keen to support and develop our staff through a clear career pathway and encourage promotional opportunities within the Trust. Please refer to the attached job description and person specification for full details of responsibilities. 1. Word processing of all forms of correspondence, reports and summaries that are required by the team. 2. Undertake diary management for clinicians and/or managers, as required. 3. Organise clinics and associated appointments for clinics, using appropriate brought forward systems to manage work. 4. Provide operational support to colleagues, and supervision of Band 2 administration staff within the team, if required, as directed by Line Manager. 5. Inputting and updating service user information and service user/team activity on computerised information systems, creating service user notes where necessary and according to policy. 6. Maintain filing in both paper and electronic records, ensuring that it is kept up to date at all times. In accordance with Trust procedures, track and receive notes in a timely manner. 7. Ensure good customer service by providing a professional and effective telephone service, taking accurate messages and providing information and signposting as requested and appropriate. 8. Undertake training of new staff as directed by Line Manager and/or other managers. 9. Provide cover as directed by Line Manager for other members of the admin team in their absence and assist with their workloads as necessary and undertake such other duties as may be reasonably required commensurate with the grade of the post.
